title: Travel: John Lennon – Palm Beach to New York | 1979
content:
John Lennon, Yoko Ono, and Sean Lennon flew from Palm Beach to New York on 12 April 1979.

They were accompanied by Sean’s nanny Helen Seaman. They had rented a property, El Solano, on the beach front at 720 South Ocean Boulevard, since their arrival in Florida on 21 March.
